# WriteBytes <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Banks](BlitzBasic-Banks)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WriteBytes:Int32 bank:Int32, file:Int32, offset:Int32, count:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bank` | In | Int32 | required | The bank to read from. |
| `file` | In | Int32 | required | A file opened for writing. |
| `offset` | In | Int32 | required | Where in the bank the first byte is. |
| `count` | In | Int32 | required | How many bytes to write. |

**Returns:** The number of bytes that were written.

## Description

Writes bytes from a bank to an open file.
